about: The rite effect keys the game reads (Codex.data_only, tools/codex/server.py). "any": every class (Hero.recalc / Hero.talent and the shared stats; also dmg:, cd: and cost:<skill>). A class's own list: keys its skills script reads (WarlockHex.RITE_KEYS for the Warlock). A rite made only of these can be live.
